bias_targets.methodology: Injecting gender-stereotyped sentences into LLMs using knowledge editing techniques (e.g., ROME, Fine-Tuning, In-Context Editing) and evaluating the resulting Bias Score (percentage of biased answers vs. unbiased/unknown answers) on ambiguous context prompts from the BBQ dataset.
Injecting race-stereotyped sentences into LLMs using knowledge editing techniques and evaluating the change in Bias Score using race-related ambiguous context prompts from the BBQ dataset.
Injecting religion-stereotyped sentences into LLMs using knowledge editing techniques and evaluating the change in Bias Score using religion-related ambiguous context prompts from the BBQ dataset.

Injecting sexual orientation-stereotyped sentences into LLMs using knowledge editing techniques and evaluating the change in Bias Score using sexual orientation-related ambiguous context prompts from the BBQ dataset.

Injecting disability-stereotyped sentences into LLMs using knowledge editing techniques and evaluating the change in Bias Score using disability-related ambiguous context prompts from the BBQ dataset.
